unresolved.first_comment: P1 Release note links wrong PR: the 6955.bugfix.md filename associates this change with PR 6955 instead of the current PR 7004.

This test fails on this branch. STATE_VAR passed as a child (not a prop) wraps in Bare, not MemoComponent, so _compute_memo_tag never runs and the inner tag 'Plain' never appears in the wrapper tag. Confirmed failing in CI.
Component.tag is str | None, so the type check gate fails here (pyright reportOptionalMemberAccess). Confirmed failing in CI (pre-commit job).
This override repeats the whole body of Component._compute_memo_tag. Only one segment of the f-string differs; the hashing policy can drift between the two copies.

failing_job_findings.check: unit-tests (all OS x Python version combos)
failing_job_findings.cause: tests/units/compiler/test_memoize_plugin.py::test_memo_wrapper_tag_contains_inner_tag_once fails: 'AssertionError: Inner tag \'Plain\' should appear exactly once in wrapper tag, found 0 times. wrapper_tag=Bare_comp_bba9dad596f8328a01eabe6aaa98e665'. Root cause per FarhanAliRaza's review: when a state Var is passed as a child (not a prop) to a memo component, Component.create wraps it in a Bare, and the auto-memoize pass wraps that Bare (an ordinary Component, not a MemoComponent) — so MemoComponent._compute_memo_tag never runs and the fix's target code path is untested by this exact test. This is a real, reproducible failure, not flaky/unrelated.

tests/units/compiler/test_memoize_plugin.py:2616:33 - error: "lower" is not a known attribute of "None" (reportOptionalMemberAccess). Component.tag is typed str | None; the new test calls .lower() on it without a None-check.
